name: Google Gemini API
notes: Limits are model- and tier-specific; Google states RPM, input TPM and RPD are evaluated independently and RPD resets at midnight Pacific time.

name: Groq
notes: Free-plan limits are model-specific. Official documentation exposes RPM, RPD, TPM, TPD and audio limits; exact values can differ by model and account.

name: Cohere
notes: Trial keys are limited to 1,000 API calls/month. Chat trial rate limit is 20 requests/minute per model for the listed chat models; other endpoints have endpoint-specific limits.

name: OpenRouter
notes: OpenRouter states a free account gets 50 requests/day and 20 requests/minute for free models; adding at least $10 in credits raises the free-model daily ceiling to 1,000 while retaining 20 RPM.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
notes: Free allocation is 10,000 Neurons/day; allocation resets daily at 00:00 UTC.

name: Cloudflare Workers
notes: Workers Free: 100,000 requests/day, 10 ms CPU/invocation, 128 MB memory, 50 subrequests/invocation, 100 Workers/account; daily limits reset at midnight UTC.

name: GitHub API
notes: Unauthenticated REST requests are limited to 60/hour per originating IP. Authenticated user requests generally have a 5,000/hour primary limit; search and secondary limits are separate.

name: Mistral AI
notes: Mistral Free mode includes monthly usage, while requests/second and tokens/minute are model-specific and shown on the account Limits page.

name: Deepgram
notes: Current catalog evidence records $200 introductory credit; concurrency limits are product/plan-specific and should not be treated as a monthly request quota.

name: ElevenLabs
notes: Official pricing lists a $0 Free plan with 10,000 credits per month.

name: Brave Search API
notes: Current plan information records $5 in free API credits per month; credit-based allowance cannot be converted to requests without endpoint pricing.

name: AssemblyAI (speech-to-text)
notes: Current official pricing/FAQ evidence records $50 free API credits for supported usage; credits are consumed rather than reset on a monthly schedule.

name: Together AI
notes: Current support documentation says Together AI does not offer free trials and requires a minimum $5 credit purchase.

name: Anthropic API
notes: Current API pricing documentation does not provide a free API quota.

name: xAI API
notes: Current pricing/billing documentation describes prepaid/invoiced API usage and does not state a free API allowance.

name: Spotify Web API
notes: Development mode requires the app owner to have Spotify Premium; up to 5 authenticated users per app. July 2026 quota counting is per developer account, shared across the account's Development Mode Client IDs.

name: NASA Open APIs
notes: DEMO_KEY is 30 requests/hour/IP and 50 requests/day/IP. Signed-up API keys normally have a higher default hourly limit; the API returns X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining headers.

name: YouTube Data API
notes: Default quota is 10,000 units/day. search.list and videos.insert have separate default allocations/usage costs; every request costs at least 1 unit.

name: Airtable API
notes: Free plan: 1,000 API calls/month per workspace; Free and Team plans are limited to 5 requests/second.

name: Supabase
notes: Free plan includes unlimited API requests but other resources are constrained: 50,000 MAU, 500 MB database, 5 GB egress, 5 GB cached egress, 1 GB file storage. Free projects pause after 1 week inactivity; max 2 active free projects.

name: Upstash
notes: Current pricing supersedes older 10K/day FAQ wording: Free Redis includes 256 MB data, 10 GB monthly bandwidth and 500K monthly commands, max 10,000 commands/sec, one free DB. An ephemeral free Redis can be created without signup but is deleted after 3 days unless claimed.

name: TMDB (movies)
notes: API is free for non-commercial use with required attribution. Commercial use requires a separate license. This is a terms-of-use constraint rather than a simple request quota.

name: MongoDB Atlas
notes: Free cluster: 0.5 GB storage, 100 operations/sec, 10 GB in + 10 GB out rolling 7 days, 500 connections, max one Free cluster/project, automatic pause after 30 days with zero connections; region availability is restricted.

name: Firebase
notes: Spark plan has no payment method. Example no-cost quotas include 50K auth MAU, Realtime Database 1 GB storage and 10 GB/month download, Hosting 10 GB storage and 360 MB/day transfer, Remote Config 100K fetches/day per project from Sep 1 2026.
